exact_missing_items: Acceptance/evidence/coverage schemas cannot express work-package/seam/promotion/account/lane identity — these schema families must be extended
Base provider envelope/spec schemas omit node/attempt/safe-point fields — these must be added to make provider envelopes node-aware
Contamination is a major gap: there is no shared event family, state object, or vocabulary for contamination classification, restore-before-reuse, or lane quarantine semantics
Plans/Multi-Account.md is missing 'Effective Identity' coverage for storage and evidence — the effective account identity must be stored and tracked with run artifacts
Runtime identity snapshots stop too early — requested/effective persona/platform/model exist but requested/effective account and execution identity do not; these must be added
Storage/event keys still lack: project_id, attempt_id, package_id, seam_id, lane_id, worktree_id, safe_point_id, promotion_class, requested/effective account fields — all must be added
